about: THE sentence TalkBack and VoiceOver say for the glucose card, on every surface that shows the card or its value (#25). Run by SpokenFixtureTest (Android, graph/A11y.kt) and SpokenFixtureTests (Mac, A11y.swift) in English and Spanish. Format: ../README.md, 'Spoken sentence'.

cases.name: in range, falling

expect.en: 112 milligrams per decilitre, falling, in range, 2 min ago
expect.es: 112 miligramos por decilitro, bajando, en rango, hace 2 min

cases.name: the very high limit is very high (#181), rising fast, just now

expect.en: 250 milligrams per decilitre, rising fast, very high, just now
expect.es: 250 miligramos por decilitro, subiendo rápido, muy alta, ahora mismo

cases.name: one word per arrow: the double arrow is very fast; the low limit is low

expect.es: 70 miligramos por decilitro, bajando muy rápido, baja, ahora mismo
